sql: SELECT tenant_id, categoria FROM iceberg.analytics.tenant_info WHERE nivel > 5
SELECT sum(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date = TIMESTAMP '2024-01-05'
SELECT status, count(*) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-01-03' GROUP BY status

SELECT d.tenant_id, COUNT(*), SUM(d.valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados d JOIN iceberg.analytics.tenant_info t ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE d.date = TIMESTAMP '2024-01-10' AND t.nivel > 5 GROUP BY d.tenant_id
SELECT max(valor), min(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-01-07'
SELECT status, count(*), avg(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados GROUP BY status

SELECT d.tenant_id, COUNT(*), SUM(d.valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados d JOIN iceberg.analytics.tenant_info t ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE d.date >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.nivel > 5 GROUP BY d.tenant_id
SELECT tenant_id, date_trunc('day', date), sum(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT t.categoria, d.status, count(*), sum(d.valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados d JOIN iceberg.analytics.tenant_info t ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id GROUP BY t.categoria, d.status
SELECT tenant_id, sum(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE valor > (SELECT avg(valor) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date = TIMESTAMP '2024-01-05') GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT count(DISTINCT surrogate_key) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados WHERE date < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
SELECT max(rn) FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY valor) AS rn FROM iceberg.analytics.dados)
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT surrogate_key FROM iceberg.analytics.dados GROUP BY surrogate_key HAVING count(*) > 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados a JOIN iceberg.analytics.dados b ON a.surrogate_key = b.surrogate_key WHERE a.date < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-15'
SELECT count(*) FROM iceberg.analytics.dados a JOIN iceberg.analytics.dados b ON a.surrogate_key = b.surrogate_key
